scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,yellow,cyan "pnpm db:wsl" "pnpm dev:api:wsl" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,yellow,cyan "pnpm db" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:files: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "cross-env STORAGE=files node scripts/cargo.mjs run" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.test: cd api && cargo test && cd ../web && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:screens
scripts.check: pnpm --dir web lint && pnpm --dir web exec tsc --noEmit && cd api && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
